title: The Rail
text: A ramp of fused rock runs due north, straight as a ruled line, climbing as it goes, with a gantry at the top. At its foot a launch log is still writing to a screen nobody reads: three entries a run, all three with the same timestamp to the millisecond. Accord, Kindred, Engram. Launched together.

lines.text: "Each launch has an upload attached, a fraction of a second before it. 'Voyage log, Sol to destination, 214 years.' Our voyage log. I've read it a hundred times. It was loaded at the bottom of this ramp."
"And the rail is aimed at Orrin, out by Halcyon. That's why its orbit is so tidy. It's the marker they steer by."

notes: The same launch instant (STORY.md §7) and the fabricated voyage logs (§12). Pays off survey-orrin.
